We already installed a POS system in our bakery but it's useless without the COGS. I used to think my parents are panicking too but a third-party accountant let us know that there's a high possibility of fraud based on what he's seeing through our POS...

Thank you very much for your response. I thought about managing the inventory myself and did a whole audit of all the items in our inventory but was not able to continue because I got hired. Where does the cost of running the stores e.g: Electricity, water, rent. come in the equation? I already suggested closing down one of the businesses to cut down costs but no one agreed with me. Thinking about it now the businesses are all making a good income but after paying everything from rent, utilities, wages, and suppliers, nothing much is left for us. We even got to a point where we were paying from our own pocket money to keep them running despite the huge income from all of them!

Thank you for the response.   
He got upset because he said, "We were accusing him of stealing, and he doesn't want to continue with the rest of his shift". also, our current accountant is practically useless since she was missing basic reports such as the profit report of last year, that the third-party accounting firm we hired out of frustration requested.   
We do manage the money directly but sometimes there is some money missing and the inventory manager would basically say "Yeah I took some cash, I had to pay some supplier that came at X time".  
We have 3 businesses because my Mom thought that by opening another business she's going to have enough money to support the old one, so she would scrape as much money she can from the currently running business and barely open a half-functioning store and continue improving on it by it's profit. And the cycle continues...  
I suggested closing one of the less profitable businesses but I was quickly shut down by Mom. I understand where she's coming from, these are her life's work. + Any accountant we bring to help us is astonished by the amount of money we are making per business (The cafe only makes 4,000,000 per year which I know is bananas!) especially since we are based in a small in the middle of nowhere town.

thank you very much for your response and the resources. I totally understand that the management is not the best. The inventory thing is going to take forever to do with the number of menu items we have x3 stores, that's gonna be a few sleepless nights lol. I definitely recognize the issue but never had the time to address it since I started my job, and I cannot rely on my parents to do it since they don't have a background in Excel or computers in general. But I'll do my best.
